title: Privacy Policy
content:
# Happy Farmer · Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 29, 2026

## 1. Overview

Happy Farmer (hereafter "the game") is developed by **LelelelingStudio** and published by **Lelelegame**. This privacy policy describes what data we collect, use, and store when you play the game.

## 2. Data We Collect

The game is a fully client-side single-player game that runs in your browser. We **do not collect** any personally identifiable information. All game data is stored locally in your device (browser localStorage / IndexedDB), including but not limited to:

- Game progress (gold, level, inventory, crop state, etc.)
- Your nickname
- Your uploaded avatar (saved locally in your browser only, never uploaded)
- Your language, layout, audio preferences

## 3. Data We Do Not Collect

- Your real name, address, phone, email
- Your location
- Your browsing history
- Your device identifiers

## 4. Browser Notifications

If you enable browser notifications in settings, the browser will request your authorization. The permission is used **only** to deliver reminders (quest complete, factory complete, etc.) when you leave the game page. We never use it to deliver advertising.

You may revoke this permission at any time via your browser's site settings.

## 5. Third-Party Services

The game uses no third-party analytics, advertising, or social-tracking services.

## 6. Save Export

When you click "Export Save", the game packages your save into a `.lelelefarmer` file downloaded to your computer. This happens entirely on your device and does not pass through any server.

## 7. Children

The game is suitable for all ages. Since it does not collect any personally identifiable information, it is especially child-friendly.

## 8. Data Deletion

You can delete all your game data at any time by:

1. Clicking "Settings → Reset Game" in-game; or
2. Clearing site data in your browser directly.

## 9. Policy Updates

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. All updates will be posted on this page and the "Last updated" date will be refreshed.

## 10. Contact

For any questions, please contact us through the official channels of **Lelelegame**.
